law_record.title: Stopping, standing or parking in restricted parking zone
law_record.text: A person shall not stop, stand or park a vehicle for any purpose or length of time in any restricted parking zone other than for the purpose to which parking in such zone is restricted, except that a driver of a passenger vehicle may stop temporarily in such zone for the purpose of and while actually engaged in loading or unloading of passengers when such stopping does not interfere with any vehicle which is waiting to enter or about to enter the zone for the purpose of parking in accordance with the purpose to which parking is restricted.

activation_conditions: the place is a restricted parking zone
the subject stops, stands or parks there for a purpose other than the one the zone is restricted to
exceptions: a passenger vehicle may stop temporarily while actually engaged in loading or unloading passengers, provided it does not interfere with a vehicle waiting or about to enter the zone for its restricted purpose
residue: the purpose a zone is restricted to is read from its sign; the subject's own purpose is interior state, evidenced only by a passenger exchange
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: 'for any purpose or length of time' — no duration makes the wrong use lawful; but the excepted loading stop is 'temporary', so a duration bound for it must be declared
the interference test runs while another vehicle waits
